verdict.rationale: The Ryzen AI software stack supports headless Linux server OSes (Ubuntu, RHEL) and exposes CLI/API-driven inference via ONNX Runtime (C++/Python APIs) and the Lemonade SDK for llama.cpp/OGA, which are automatable without a GUI. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI pipelines, containerized/Docker deployment, or automated build/test workflows for this hardware. Missing for 10: explicit CI/automation examples, containerization support, and independent confirmation of headless scripted runs.
